name: Ruben King
life: “I still remember buying a concert seat I had no business pretending was cheap.” People around Breakwater Way know Ruben by a small Monday habit. Ruben stops on the landward side of the cycle track to watch the first boats turn for home.
voice: I spent my student loan on a ticket to hear the original singer. I stayed for the new one.
appearance: On an ordinary day, look for a charcoal zip cardigan and a replacement button a shade darker than the others. Ruben has a long face and high cheekbones, with a cropped cut that shows the shape of the ears. Ruben raises one eyebrow long before saying yes during a conversation.
personality: Ruben is fond of ambitious ideas and deeply suspicious of grand openings. The question Ruben asks at any launch is who has the keys for cleaning up a month later.
agenda: To hear the full show even after the casting change.
family: Scout Hull is Ruben’s cousin. Ruben sets the time to leave. Scout picks the meeting place. It lets them stay close without turning a family visit into the loss of an entire day. They have both had stretches when that distinction mattered. Asked about *Summer staff*, Scout says, “I rented a room through September and my final lifeguard check comes in August.”
connections: Aria Miller. A listener who bought a ticket for one voice hears the sibling's harmony with another.

reactions.situation: The understudy is offered the lead before the announcement
reactions.response: Ruben asks that the lead singer hear the change directly before it is advertised.
reactions.asWritten: The understudy is offered the lead before the announcement. Ruben asks that the lead singer hear the change directly before it is advertised.

reactions.situation: A coworker arrives late after a night at the hospital
reactions.response: Ruben asks them privately what can be shared about the delay and respects the answer.
